issue_type.description: Type of issue (e.g., budget overruns, ethical concerns, strategic pivot).
issue_type.title: Issue Type

escalation_level.description: Indicates the governance body or role to which the issue is escalated (e.g., Steering Committee).
escalation_level.title: Escalation Level

approval_process.description: Outlines how an issue is approved or resolved once escalated (e.g., majority vote).
approval_process.title: Approval Process

rationale.description: Explains *why* this issue triggers escalation—i.e. potential impacts or risks that justify escalating.
rationale.title: Rationale

negative_consequences.description: Describes the potential adverse outcomes or risks if this issue remains unresolved or is not escalated in a timely manner.
negative_consequences.title: Negative Consequences

decision_escalation_matrix.description: Clear escalation paths for various issues.
decision_escalation_matrix.title: Decision Escalation Matrix
